summary: Gogoro Inc., a Taiwan-domiciled Nasdaq-listed foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K containing its press release of November 11, 2026 reporting third-quarter results for the period ended September 30, 2026. The filing is a routine earnings disclosure, not a special situation. Reported items include record quarterly gross margins of 24.4% under both IFRS and non-IFRS versus 12.2% and 22.2% a year earlier, and operating cash flow up 8.8% year-over-year to $27.9 million for the first nine months of 2026, marking six consecutive quarters of positive operating cash generation. Business commentary covered the Luna and EZZY product lines, the Castrol Gogoro Mobility joint venture's Vietnam battery-swapping rollout, and delivery-platform pilot partnerships. No transaction terms, board recommendations, advisors, or structural mechanics were disclosed. What to watch is continued margin durability, cash generation, and Vietnam expansion execution rather than any deal catalyst.
